product.title: Pike Place Market Tasting Tour

description.text: Sample Pike Place Market on a guided food and culture walking tour with tastings from local vendors. The route covers market stalls, specialty foods, and the history of Seattle's most famous public market.

highlights: Guided Pike Place Market tasting tour
Multiple food samples from market vendors
Walking route through main market levels

start.description: Meet at 1901 Western Ave Suite E on the covered ramp outside Honest Biscuits at the north end of Pike Place Market.

end.description: Tour ends near Bottega Italiana Gelato at 1425 1st Avenue.

product.itinerarySummary: Sample Pike Place Market on a guided food and culture walking tour with tastings from local vendors.

itineraryItems.title: Pike Place Market
itineraryItems.description: Meet at the market edge before entering the main hall for the tasting route.

itineraryItems.title: Market vendor tastings
itineraryItems.description: Sample produce, smoked salmon, pastries, and specialty items from curated market stalls.

itineraryItems.title: Market history
itineraryItems.description: Learn how Pike Place Market began more than a century ago while moving between food stops.

additionalInfo: Confirmation will be received at time of booking

faqs.question: How long is the Pike Place Market Tasting Tour?

faqs.answer: Meet at 1901 Western Ave Suite E on the covered ramp outside Honest Biscuits at the north end of Pike Place Market.
